title: SEO Site Profile
description: Personalised SEO/GEO criteria for one site. Data only — selects and prioritises, never invents metrics. Consumed by skills via {{site:<key>}} tokens and by seo/gsc_metrics.py, seo/coverage.py, seo/site_crawl.py.

language_paths.description: Language code -> URL path prefix starting and ending with '/' (e.g. {"EN": "/", "RU": "/ru/"}). Language = longest matching prefix.

sections.description: Site sections / page templates, e.g. Service pages, Blog, Homepage

priority_keywords.description: Non-brand keywords that matter most, grouped by language code (keys must be in `languages`). Brand terms belong in brand_terms only.

brand_terms.description: Brand terms incl. spelling/script variants; matching is case-, punctuation- and spacing-insensitive

markets.description: Target markets (ISO country codes, or the sentinel WORLDWIDE)

ai_sources.description: AI-assistant referrer hosts; subdomains match too. Single source for the GA4 AI filter (site_profile.py --ga4-ai-filter).

ads_customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID used for Keyword Planner calls

ads_language_constants.description: Language code -> Keyword Planner language resource. Verify with GAQL: SELECT language_constant.id, language_constant.code FROM language_constant

ads_geo_targets.description: Keyword Planner geo targets (max 10); empty = all locations (use for WORLDWIDE)

serp_locations.description: Language code -> DataForSEO location_code for live SERP checks. Unset = ask the user which market to sample.

thresholds.description: Per-site overrides of seo/gsc_metrics.py DEFAULTS (see domain-knowledge.md for meaning).
